name: Psalms & Prayer
description: Three weeks of praying with the Psalms, plus two New Testament chapters on prayer. Read slowly, and try praying a line or two in your own words.

days.title: Two paths
days.explanation: The Psalms open by contrasting a life rooted in God, like a tree by water, with a life that blows away.

days.title: How majestic
days.explanation: Looking at the night sky, the psalmist wonders why God cares so much about people.

days.title: The heavens declare
days.explanation: God speaks through creation and through his word. The psalm ends with a prayer many people still use.

days.title: The Lord is my shepherd
days.explanation: A psalm of trust for every season of life, including the darkest valleys.

days.title: Whom shall I fear?
days.explanation: A prayer for times of fear, asking to see God's goodness and learning to wait for him.

days.title: The joy of forgiveness
days.explanation: David describes the weight of hidden sin and the relief of confessing it to God.

days.title: Taste and see
days.explanation: A song of thanks from someone God rescued, with a promise that he is near the brokenhearted.

days.title: Thirsty for God
days.explanation: A prayer for times of discouragement: "Why art thou cast down, O my soul?"

days.title: Be still
days.explanation: God is our refuge even when everything around us shakes.

days.title: A clean heart
days.explanation: David's prayer of repentance. A model for being honest with God about failure.

days.title: Wait in silence
days.explanation: A quiet psalm about resting in God alone when others are unreliable.

days.title: In a dry land
days.explanation: Written in the wilderness, a prayer of longing for God that ends in joy.

days.title: Teach us to number our days
days.explanation: A prayer of Moses about the shortness of life and the everlasting God.

days.title: Under his wings
days.explanation: A psalm of protection for anyone who feels unsafe.

days.title: Bless the Lord
days.explanation: David reminds himself of everything God has done: forgiving, healing, redeeming, and showing compassion.

days.title: Where help comes from
days.explanation: A song pilgrims sang on the way to Jerusalem: my help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

days.title: Search me
days.explanation: God knows us completely and is always with us. It ends with an invitation for God to search our hearts.

days.title: Great is the Lord
days.explanation: A psalm of praise for God's greatness, kindness, and nearness to all who call on him.

days.title: The Lord's Prayer
days.explanation: Jesus teaches his followers how to pray, simply and without showing off.

days.title: Instead of worrying
days.explanation: Paul encourages bringing everything to God in prayer, with the promise of his peace.

days.title: Let everything praise
days.explanation: The Book of Psalms ends with pure praise. Finish these three weeks the same way.
